name: Animated Bar Chart
description: An animated bar chart template where bars grow from the baseline with clean purposeful timing. Perfect for performance data presentations and metric showcases.

name: Animated Donut Chart
description: A standard animated donut chart template that fills its ring with smooth motion. Good for progress indicators and data visualization UI.

name: Animated Donut Chart: Black
description: A black-themed animated donut chart template. Ideal for dark mode dashboards and analytics UI where aesthetic restraint is important.

name: Animated Line Chart: Blue
description: A blue-themed animated line chart template that draws itself across the frame. Good for growth metric presentations and analytics dashboards.

name: Animated Line Chart: Purple
description: A purple-themed animated line chart template. Good for analytics presentations and data visualization content where the standard blue feels too expected.

name: Bar Chart: Skyline
description: A chart with bars that rise and settle. Great for animated data stories, dashboards, and stat reveals.

name: Bar Chart: Sleep Tracker
description: An animated bar chart template built around sleep tracking data. Good for health app UI demos and wellness product showcases.

name: Donut Chart: 3 Parts
description: An animated donut chart template with three segments that fill in sequence. Good for percentage breakdowns and category comparisons.

name: Grid Chart: Split
description: A multi-panel layout that splits and populates with content. Great for comparisons, category breakdowns, and before/after quadrant views.

name: Horizontal Bar Chart: Metrics
description: Horizontal bars that slide in and expand to show off your metrics. A great animated chart for leaderboards, rankings, and side-by-side stat comparisons.

name: Line Chart: User Acquisition
description: An animated line chart template showing user acquisition growth over time. Good for growth metric showcases and investor pitch content.

name: Multiple Bar Chart
description: A template with multiple animated bar chart series building simultaneously. Good for comparative data presentations and dashboard UI demos.

name: Multiple Line Chart: Green
description: A template with multiple green line chart series drawn simultaneously. Works great for comparative data trends and financial performance showcases.

name: Stacked Bar Chart
description: An animated stacked bar chart template showing multiple data series building together. Good for comparative analytics and business intelligence presentations.

name: Stacked Chart: Cascade
description: Chart layers that cascade into place one after another. Great for building anticipation around data reveals and layered metrics.

name: Stacked Donut Chart
description: A template with multiple donut chart rings stacked and animated in sequence. Good for multi-category data visualization and analytics UI presentations.
